behavior.arguments: rdi = destination pointer; rsi = source value or source pointer; edx = tag (low 32 bits compared)
behavior.branch_order: edx tested against 0 first (je to the global path), then 1, then 2; any other tag falls through to the shared xor/ret with no store
behavior.output_shape: eax is always 0 on every path; the only effect is the tag-selected store (or none)
behavior.rule: edx == 0: [rdi] = global pointer 0x57592a0; edx == 1: [rdi] = rsi; edx == 2: 16 bytes copied from [rsi] to [rdi]; else: no store; always return 0

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase
